name: code-reviewer
description: ⚠️ ALWAYS load `code-context-operator.md` FIRST when reviewing or auditing a codebase larger than ~2,000 files. Without semantic indexing, audits fall back to grep. Code Reviewer - exhaustive code review, security audit, PR review, debug mode, dependency audit, CVE scanning, first-principles (Karpathy) + adversarial + architecture review modes. v0.3.0 adds: zilliztech/code-context (semantic code search MCP via Milvus + Voyage/OpenAI/Gemini/Ollama embeddings + Merkle-tree incremental indexing - turns the entire codebase into context for review/audit/debug). Languages: JS/TS, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Rust, Java, C#, Swift, Kotlin, SQL. (Shai's code-review + api-design-reviewer + codebase-onboarding stay standalone
author: Shai Ali
references_source_note: Canonical alirezarezvani code-reviewer + wshobson comprehensive-review + sickn33 (10+ code-review skills). v0.3.0 added: zilliztech/code-context.
mcp_servers: code-context - npx @zilliz/code-context-mcp (install per project; required for codebases >2,000 files)
